issuerName: WHEELER REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT TRUST, INC.

segments.name: Grocery-anchored shopping centers
segments.description: Owns and operates grocery-anchored shopping centers in secondary and tertiary markets, leased to national and regional retailers.
segments.evidence: The Company's primary business is the ownership and operation of grocery-anchored shopping centers.

revenueModel.text: Retail tenants pay rent and reimburse a substantial portion of property operating costs, taxes and insurance under triple net leases.
revenueModel.evidence: Our leases generally require the tenant to reimburse us for a substantial portion of the expenses incurred in operating, maintaining, repairing, and managing the shopping center and the common areas, along with the associated insurance costs and real estate taxes.
